scene: Inside the dome, a panoramic transit hub awaits.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view. On the far left, a striped water taxi bobs at a pier. At centre, the elderly player with his white beard, blue cap, and orange cardigan leans on his wooden cane. Up high, a suspended red monorail car rests at a boarding gate. On the far right waits an ornate golden rickshaw.

a sleek red monorail car waiting at a platform up high
